theme: An open day with one call, and a few travel calls quietly due.
greeting: The calendar is nearly empty today, Dan — just the afternoon call with Pema. The weight is off the schedule and in a few travel decisions that have come due before the girls head to Jen's on Sunday.

needsAttention.title: December break destination
needsAttention.detail: The shortlist was due Sept 30 and the book-by is Oct 15; holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year, so the domestic vs. refundable-international call is what unlocks everything after it.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market — booking it refundable now costs nothing and takes the sell-out risk off the table.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive south
needsAttention.detail: The Portland–to–St Pete drive window is Oct 5–18 and the girls leave Sunday; the one open piece is the hotel night, bookable the moment you and Mike lock the dates.

flagged.title: Apple wants you to sign in
flagged.detail: To keep the new iPhone 17e under AppleCare One, Apple is asking you to sign in with the account tied to the plan.

flagged.title: Oct 25 meeting materials
flagged.detail: David Wetherbee sent the DIRA & DIBA packet ahead of the Oct 25 meeting — worth a read before then; no reply needed now.

inbox.noise: The rest is LinkedIn job alerts, receipts, a book delivery, and newsletters.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on your reply.

acts.line: The morning is wide open, with nothing booked until mid-afternoon.
A single call breaks the quiet around half past two, then the day reopens.
A clear evening, well suited to the December and Christmas-travel calls before Sunday's handoff.
